# Pinehaven Self Storage - pricing FAQ

Q: Is there a minimum rental term?
A: Climate-controlled units carry a minimum stay of 8 weeks. After the first
eight weeks your rental continues week to week, and you can end it any time
with 14 days notice.

Q: Do standard units have a minimum term?
A: Standard drive-up units rent week to week from day one.

Q: Is there a discount?
A: Autopay takes 5% off the weekly rate.

Q: What fits in a climate-controlled unit?
A: The 5x8 unit holds the contents of a one-room studio; the 10x10 holds a
two-bedroom flat.
